free_tier.stated: No standing free tier: a new organization starts at USD 0 and credit must be added before a sandbox can be created; promo codes add credit and the docs refer to trial and promotion credit, but no amount or duration is published on the pages read. Unverified: whether the advertised USD 10 free credit is granted to every new account.
free_tier.notes: A search snippet of the vendor homepage says '$10 free credit', but the homepage HTML read on 2026-11-25 does not carry that phrase, and the billing docs say a new org starts at $0. The list's $0.108/h is the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB rate: $0.0324/vCPU-hour plus $0.0108/GiB-hour.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is a running microVM, not a stored object; the free tier caps a sandbox at 2 vCPU, 2 GiB RAM and 10 GB disk

retention.stated: Data is not deleted when a balance runs out: a stopped sandbox keeps its disk and is archived after 7 days by default at a lower disk rate, and snapshots and volumes keep billing.

egress.terms: Egress is the data a sandbox sends to public internet addresses and is priced at $0.04 per GiB; inbound data, preview URL traffic, sandbox-to-sandbox traffic and volume traffic do not count.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 0.04 per GiB (USD 40.96 per TiB, derived: 1024 GiB x USD 0.04)

interface_detail: REST API at api.platinum.dev/v1, TypeScript and Python SDKs, an MCP server, a pt CLI, a dashboard, and terminal/SSH into a sandbox. Each sandbox is a Cloud Hypervisor microVM on KVM.
tooling: The user installs the pt CLI or an SDK and passes a scoped API key; a self-hosted control plane is documented separately and is not the hosted offer priced here.
chaining: Prepaid metered microVMs can run agent code for a short task and stop to a disk-only bill between calls, which pairs with a separate object-storage record for longer-lived artifacts.

limits.value: A new org starts at USD 0 balance; credit packs are USD 10, 50 or 200, or USD 5 to 1,000 custom; running sandboxes get a 60-minute grace period at a zero balance and are then auto-stopped, never deleted
Free tier: 2 vCPU, 2 GiB RAM, 10 GB disk per sandbox and 4 vCPU, 8 GiB, 40 GB org total running at once; tiers rise with a verified email and $5 paid, a saved card and $25 paid, and so on

limits_note: Rates per second while running: $0.0324 per vCPU-hour, $0.0108 per GiB RAM-hour, $0.000072 per GB disk-hour ($0.0526 per GB-month); a stopped sandbox bills only disk and snapshots. GPU attachments are free.
binding_note: Prepaid balance is what stops new sandboxes first: at a zero balance every new create answers 402 insufficient_credits, before the free org's 4-vCPU concurrency cap is reached.

identity_cost.detail: An account is created at https://www.platinum.dev/dashboard#signup and an API key minted there; the higher sandbox tiers require 'a verified email and $5 paid' and then 'a verified email, a saved card and $25 paid'. Credits are bought through a Stripe-hosted checkout and auto top-up needs a saved card. A card is not shown as required merely to open a new org, but the advertised free credit is not established by the pages read.

reliability_note: At a zero balance new compute answers 402 and running sandboxes stop after a 60-minute grace period; data is never deleted for lack of credit, though a user-configured auto_delete_days timer still applies.
confidence_note: Rates, tier limits, zero-balance behaviour, account creation and egress pricing are quoted from the first-party billing docs and documentation index read on 2026-11-25; the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB = $0.108/h arithmetic is quoted from the documentation index itself.
